free_tier.stated: Storage boxes from 4 TB to 32 TB with SFTP, SSH, and Docker rootless. Unlimited bandwidth at 100Mbps plus 10Gbps burst. RAID5 or RAID0. Own hardware in Finland.

per_object_cap.notes: The wiki lists SFTP, FTP/FTPS, SCP, rsync, WebDAV, HTTP/HTTPS and SSHFS access, with no artificial protocol restrictions and no per-object size cap.

retention.notes: The 7-day period is a temporary 25% storage-quota overage allowance, not a data retention term.

egress.terms: Internet egress: Unlimited at 100 Mbps (~30 TB/month, ~1 TB/day). Burst egress: 10 Gbps, 500 GiB per 30 days. DC internal: Unlimited at 10 Gbps. Ingress: Unlimited at 10 Gbps.

interface_detail: SFTP, SCP, FTP(S), rsync, WebDAV, HTTP(S), SSHFS, SSH, Docker rootless, BorgBackup, Restic, rclone
tooling: rclone as a plain SFTP/WebDAV destination; Borg and Restic preinstalled; full rclone serve s3 / MinIO possible via docker rootless
chaining: rclone mounts this storage box as a folder on a seedbox with its cache on the seedbox's fast disk.

limits.value: 100 Mbps sustained internet egress; 10 Gbps burst capped at 500 GiB/month

limits_note: CPU/IO fair-use (0.5-1 core, standard IO priority). RAID5 survives one drive. 25% burst quota above allocation; bonus disk grows with account age. Live fleet stats published (median 25.7 users/server, 37.1 ms disk response, 24.1% disks busy). Unusually honest disclosure.
reliability_note: Finnish own hardware (Helsinki Lauttasaari, Kerava). V-series is RAID0. Pick M-series. Not a hyperscaler; a one-shop provider.
confidence_note: Storage boxes from 4 TB to 32 TB with SFTP, SSH, and Docker rootless. Unlimited bandwidth at 100Mbps plus 10Gbps burst. RAID5 or RAID0. Own hardware in Finland.
